Help for the public commands: `mcp-console`, `serve`, `sandbox`, `config`, `config resolve`, and `configure-client`.
For examples, see [Command-line reference](CLI.md).

The text comes from the CLI acceptance snapshots.
Run `mcp-console --help` to see the help for your installed version.
On narrow screens, scroll within a help block to see the complete line.
